expectation: Membrane rings on APCs (macrophages, dendritic cells, B cells), plus some activated T cells and tumour cells. Common in immune-rich stroma, where they should form dense networks and aggregates; scattered single cells elsewhere; little in tumour nests that lack it.
observed: A: strong cellular networks in stromal and immune-rich cores, with clear dark nests and a few near-empty cores. B/C: scattered cells in streaks along stroma. D: bright cell outlines. E1: membrane rings in a meshwork; E3 has many white overlaps on CD14 cells plus extra green HLADR+ CD14- cells.
why: HLADR outlines cell membranes in immune and stromal regions, overlaps a subset of CD14 cells and varies between cores as tissue structure would, not as haze or grain.
notes: Strong membrane-ring networks in the immune-rich stroma, sparing tumour nests and some cores. Many cells overlap CD14 cells, and extra HLADR+ CD14- cells fit B cells or dendritic cells. This is a convincing specific stain.
